name: Beretvale
summary: Melbourne operating company behind the HoloHost then Nella Networks ISP (Beretvale Pty Ltd); associated with the R B Allen Family Trust; Nella Telecommunications separated out c.2004, Beretvale later deregistered.

events.details: Beretvale Pty Ltd ran the HoloHost ISP from c.1998, so the company predates the 24 Mar 2000 R B Allen Family Trust ABN.
HoloHost/Nella Networks became Nella Telecommunications, which separated out from Beretvale c.2004; Beretvale later deregistered.

ABN 93 132 994 466 (cited for Beretvale) is on ABR THE R B ALLEN FAMILY TRUST, a discretionary investment trust in VIC active from 24 Mar 2000 — the associated family trust, not the company Beretvale Pty Ltd itself.
